description: Leave a rating for the connected person's own DELIVERED order: food quality, delivery speed and packaging, each 1 to 5, an optional short comment, and optionally a rating for the rider. One rating per order; a repeat returns the existing one. The scores are the person's own. If the connection is set to confirm each decision, the first call returns the scores and submits nothing until a call with confirmed: true.

confirmed.description: True records that the person agreed to submit these scores

orderCode.description: The order code returned when the order was placed, e.g. WA-K4M2

restaurantId.description: The venue the order was placed at (needed with orderCode if the person has the same code at two venues)

name: rate_order
title: Rate a delivered order
